_doc: The domain language applied to this business (references/14-domain-language.md). The structure of the site is shared across projects; everything in this file is why it looks and speaks like Eden Cosmetics and nobody else.
domain: professional beauty supply: lash and brow lift, sold by a practitioner and trainer
audience: lash and brow technicians (mostly small home or salon businesses), students, and some private buyers; they know the craft and the brands, and they buy by treatment, price, stock and free-shipping threshold
feeling: an atelier: calm, warm, precise, feminine without kitsch; the confidence of someone who does the work
commercialJob: turn 'which kit and what else do I need' into a cart in the store, or a WhatsApp message to Eden
signature: the curl: a straight line that lifts into a curve (a lash after a lift, the tail of the E in the logo); the lotus of the logo and Lotti born from it

type.display: Frank Ruhl Libre (Hebrew serif, editorial weight)
type.latin: Cinzel for the wordmark only; brand names take their own typographic character on the shelf

palette.rule: brand colours appear only inside that brand's panel and page, measured from its real packaging

imagery.products: the store's own photos; on stages, real cutouts that keep every product pixel (cutouts.json, PSNR ≥ 32 dB)
imagery.atmosphere: at most five generated concepts (visual/concepts.json): the atelier surface, the curl, the craft, brand fields, the lotus
imagery.never: generated products, logos, text, faces or results; stock clichés of beauty (scattered petals on marble, fanned brushes, spa stones)

layout.firstScreen: headline and the two actions on the first mobile screen; a flat lay of real products on the atelier surface; a live kit card (the proof tool's answer) and the brand line
layout.density: compact and scannable: counts, prices, stock and the free-shipping gap are always visible; long text only where a buyer needs it (policies, guides)
layout.clean: the shop grid, the kit builder, the cart and the forms stay imagery-free and content-first

motion: slow and precise: products settle onto the surface, the curl draws in section headers, cards lift on hover; nothing moves on its own after the first seconds; reduced motion removes all of it

voice.address: one woman (את) in conversation; actions named with an infinitive or a noun
voice.tone: plain, warm, exact; numbers instead of adjectives; no superlatives nobody can check

guide: Lotti: a quiet corner guide who speaks only when useful, never over the first screen, never while the visitor types; she tours the brands and answers from the site's facts
notThis: a luxury perfume site (too cold, too dark)
a spa site (too soft, no commerce)
